scenes.text: Do you honestly believe the Sahara Desert has always been just a barren, endless wasteland of dry, scorching sand?

You are actually living in a brief intermission of a massive geological cycle, because every twenty thousand years, our Earth wobbles on its axis and shifts monsoon rains directly over northern Africa.

This planetary wobble completely transforms the entire desert into a lush, green tropical paradise filled with massive lakes, flowing rivers, and incredible wildlife, as proven by ancient cave paintings of humans swimming in areas that are now bone dry.

Scientists prove this green phase will inevitably return to swallow the yellow dunes, so tell me in the comments if you would want to see this beautiful paradise, and hit follow for more amazing history!
